correctness.rationale: Admissibility keeps operating resources nonnegative, so the proportional clearing update maps [0,1]^n into itself. The row-wise Lipschitz constants are lambda_i<1; hence the fixed point exists uniquely. In deficits put Lambda_i=product_{j=0}^{i-1} lambda_j and T_i=sum_{j=1}^i s_j/Lambda_j. Induction along the unshocked banks gives d_i=Lambda_i(d_0-T_i)_+; the induction uses s_i>0 to absorb the outer positive part. If sigma<=s_0+T_{n-1}, the candidate d_0=(sigma-s_0)_+ has d_{n-1}=0 and satisfies the fixed-point equations. Since the T_i strictly increase, exactly the stated prefix defaults, with equality at tau_i leaving bank i solvent. If sigma>s_0+T_{n-1}, the actual fixed point has d_0>=sigma-s_0>T_{n-1}, which forces every downstream deficit positive. In this branch closing the ring gives the stated derivative 1/(1-product_i lambda_i) at bank 0 and its downstream attenuations. The full-cascade interval can be empty, and even at its boundary the last bank still pays in full. This proof does not assume a feasible shock reaches a formal threshold.
residual_risks: The recorded exact-rational run concerns two points in a four-bank example only. The proof, not the example, establishes the statement for general n and at the interval boundaries.

originality.rationale: The heterogeneous all-depth formula is more explicit than the related homogeneous-cycle and ring endpoint statements inspected. It is nevertheless a mechanical specialization of proportional clearing: each unshocked node has a single incoming payment, and each scalar positive-part affine deficit map has positive slope and negative intercept. Composing them gives a single hinge with a back-discounted sum for its break point; applying the closing equation below and above the final hinge gives the whole claimed classification. This is direct implication, not a claim that the exact heterogeneous list was found in prior literature. A missing lawful full-text copy of Eisenberg–Noe is not the grounds for failure.
residual_risks: Full-text Eisenberg–Noe comparison remains unavailable; no negative whole-document inference is made.

The Eboli 2019 passage is from a submitted version; numerical equivalence of its endpoint parameterization to the homogeneous proportional-ring specialization was not established. Neither limitation removes the direct implication from the clearing recursion.

value.rationale: Thresholds for contagion depth are a natural quantity, and the expression is a convenient benchmark for a toy topology. In this model the sole-predecessor and single-shock restrictions reduce the entire question to serial evaluation of one scalar hinge and a one-equation closure once every bank defaults. The exact thresholds are mechanically implied, and the finding adds no nonroutine multi-path effect, previously unresolved comparable-model threshold mechanism, or distinct structural result beyond this calculation.
residual_risks: The judgment concerns this precise serial proportional-clearing example; it does not apply to other ring models, heterogeneous networks with multiple creditors, or multi-source shocks.
